items.title: Will Hrithik Roshan and Laxman Utekar Collaborate on New Film? Exclusive Details
items.summary:
Hrithik Roshan is currently evaluating the prospect of Laxman Utekar's latest script. Here's what we know about the same.

An intriguing new pairing may be brewing in Bollywood, and this one brings together an established superstar with...
items.description:
Hrithik Roshan is currently evaluating the prospect of Laxman Utekar's latest script. Here's what we know about the same.

An intriguing new pairing may be brewing in Bollywood, and this one brings together an established superstar with one of the industry's hottest directors of the moment. Filmfare has learnt that Laxman Utekar, fresh off the success of Chhaava, is eyeing Hrithik Roshan for his next directorial venture.

A source close to the development reveals, "Laxman Utekar has an exciting new script and he's zeroed in on Hrithik Roshan. For now, Hrithik is listening to the narration, and those in the know have revealed that he too is excited about the story. But things are far from being final. We'll have to wait and watch if this collaboration comes to fruition."

 

If it does come together, it would mark the first time Hrithik and Utekar have worked with each other, a meeting point between Utekar's recent run of genre-hopping successes (Luka Chuppi, Mimi, Zara Hatke Zara Bachke, and the period actioner Chhaava) and Hrithik's action-hero legacy. Utekar currently has Eetha, his period musical drama starring Shraddha Kapoor, locked for a December 4 release, which suggests any Hrithik collaboration would likely be some time away from going on floors.

The timing is notable for Hrithik as well. With War 2 behind him and Krrish 4, his directorial debut, reportedly facing delays over budget and scheduling, industry buzz has suggested the actor may be open to a mass entertainer in the interim, making a script exciting enough to pull him in from a filmmaker on as hot a streak as Utekar an appealing prospect.

Both camps have stayed tight-lipped, and as our source notes, the narration stage is far from a confirmed deal. Filmfare will watch this development closely and bring you any future updates. We'll be hoping that Hrithik and Utekar find the creative zing and end up making a memorable movie.

items.title: Sajid Khan to Collaborate With Akshay Kumar Again - Exclusive
items.summary: It's shaping up to be a full-circle moment for Bollywood's one-time hit machine. Filmfare has learnt that Sajid Khan is set to reunite with Akshay Kumar for a new film, marking their first collaboration since Housefull 2 over a decade...
items.description:
It's shaping up to be a full-circle moment for Bollywood's one-time hit machine. Filmfare has learnt that Sajid Khan is set to reunite with Akshay Kumar for a new film, marking their first collaboration since Housefull 2 over a decade ago.

A source close to the development reveals, "Sajid Khan will direct Akshay Kumar again. Their new film has been green lit by the production house. Sajid is currently working on Yashvardhan Ahuja's film with Nitanshi Goel. Once that's wrapped up, Sajid and Akshay will shoot their film in London."

The reunion comes at a significant point in Sajid's career arc. He and Akshay were once one of the industry's most bankable director-actor pairs, delivering back-to-back successes with Heyy Babyy, Housefull, and Housefull 2. That partnership came to an abrupt halt in 2018, when Sajid stepped down from Housefull 4 after being named in multiple sexual harassment allegations during the #MeToo movement. Akshay had since maintained that he'd be open to working with Sajid again if the filmmaker was acquitted, and with Sajid's directorial comeback already underway, the timing of this reported reunion won't go unnoticed.

That comeback is currently in motion with Hero Ki Horrorine, the horror-comedy marking the Bollywood debut of Yashvardhan Ahuja, Govinda's son, opposite Laapataa Ladies breakout Nitanshi Goel. The film is backed by Ekta Kapoor and Shobha Kapoor's Balaji Telefilms alongside producer Amar Butala, the same production house reportedly circling the Khan-Kumar reunion as well.

Once Hero Ki Horrorine wraps, our source indicates Sajid and Akshay will head to London to begin filming their project, though further details on cast, title, and genre remain under wraps for now.

items.title: Are Veer Pahariya and Anjini Dhawan Dating? Heres Exclusive Details

Veer and Anjini had a recent outing in London that's got their respective friends circle buzzing. Read the full story here.

Bollywood has a new couple, and this one comes with a familiar surname attached.
items.description:
Veer and Anjini had a recent outing in London that's got their respective friends circle buzzing. Read the full story here.

Bollywood has a new couple, and this one comes with a familiar surname attached. Filmfare can exclusively confirm that Sky Force actor Veer Pahariya and Sikandar actress Anjini Dhawan, niece of Varun Dhawan and part of the extended Dhawan film family, are in a relationship.

A source close to the two reveals, "Veer and Anjini are seeing each other. They recently had a summer getaway in London. Anjini's friends are all excited about her new relationship and have been reacting to all her personal updates on their social network."

The London trip marks the couple's first getaway together, and it's clear their relationship already has the backing of their inner circle. Anjini's friends have been openly engaging with her personal updates online, a sign that this isn't a fledgling romance but one that's been building quietly for a while now.

Both actors are currently riding high professionally, which may explain the discretion so far. Veer, who debuted opposite Akshay Kumar in Sky Force, is currently earning attention for his romantic comedy Prem Keetanu. Anjini, who stepped into Bollywood with Binny & Family in 2024, followed it up with a role in the Salman Khan-starrer Sikandar, keeping her steadily in the spotlight as she carves her own identity within Bollywood's most storied film family.

Neither Veer nor Anjini has addressed the relationship publicly yet and given the Dhawans' track record of keeping personal milestones private until they're ready, an official confirmation will likely come on their own terms. But with their circle already in the know and the London trip out in the open, this is one relationship that's now firmly out of the shadows. items.title: Park Hae-Soo Welcome His Second Child
items.summary: Park Hae-Soo is back in the news and for all the right reasons. He and his wife welcomed their second son on August 23, 2026.
items.description:
Park Hae-Soo is back in the news and for all the right reasons. He and his wife welcomed their second son on August 23, 2026. Just over a month back, on July 31, 2026, Park Hae-Soo revealed to the world during the 5th Blue Dragon Series Award that he and his wife were pregnant. The occasion could have been no more perfect than this, considering that he had just received the Best Actor award for his performance in the thriller series, The Scarecrow. During his acceptance speech, he expressed his gratitude to his family proudly adding, "Daddy won an award!"

The Scarecrow actor, Park Hae-Soo and his wife welcomed their baby boy with the actor's agency confirming that both the mother and the child were healthy. This news was officially confirmed by BH Entertainment via the Korean media on August 24. The couple married in January 2019. Park Hae-Soo and his wife welcomed their first son, five years back in 2021. Ironically, their son was birthed on the same day as the release date of the hit show he starred in as an antagonist, Squid Games, on September 17, 2021.

View this post on Instagram

Squid Games had seen one of the most generational runs in this decade. The first season released back in September of 2021. The first month was a rather calm one for an unexpected and unprecedented phenomenon to occur. Squid Game skyrocketed his career right after. Even though he unfortunately during the climax of the first season, what followed were a set of concurrent hits, including Yaksha: Ruthless Operations, Karma, and the recent, The Scarecrow.

 

In June 2026, Park Hae-Soo was also confirmed to co-star alongside Jung-Suk in the new Netflix Drama, Paper Man.

items.title: Donât Be Shy: Alia Bhatt Reveals Four Fresh Faces Wholl Lead The Romantic Comedy
items.summary:
Prime Video has announced a September premiere for Don’t Be Shy, a young-adult romantic comedy backed by Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt’s Eternal Sunshine Productions.

Written and directed by Sreeti Mukerji, the young-adult film is produced...
items.description:
Prime Video has announced a September premiere for Don’t Be Shy, a young-adult romantic comedy backed by Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt’s Eternal Sunshine Productions.

Written and directed by Sreeti Mukerji, the young-adult film is produced by Alia and Shaheen Bhatt, with Grishma Shah and Vikesh Bhutani serving as co-producers.

The film marks the debut of four newcomers Aarushi Bajaj, Ansh Duggal, Bianca Arora and Piyush Khati in lead roles. Aarushi Bajaj, who was born and raised in Pune, moved to Mumbai to pursue an undergraduate degree in Liberal Arts from NMIMS, where she explored theatre and filmmaking. She began her career with commercials and made her acting debut in 2023 with series Aarya. She was later seen in Raat Akeli Hai: The Bansal Murders (2025).

View this post on Instagram

Ansh Duggal started his career in modelling and advertising before venturing into music videos and acting. He made his acting debut with Nakhrewaalii, a romantic comedy produced by Aanand L Rai.

Piyush Khati, who hails from town of Ranikhet in Uttarakhand, is best known for playing Dheeraj Kumar in Netflix’s young adult series CLASS. He has also appeared in shows such as Criminal Justice and Karmma Calling, among other projects, and was part of Extraction as well.

Bianca Arora has previously appeared in several web projects, including the 2024 series 36 Days and the 2025 show Power of Paanch. With the upcoming film, she joins Aarushi, Ansh and Piyush as one of the four newcomers taking on a lead role.

The story explores themes of friendship, young love, heartbreak and navigating the challenges of young adulthood. Kunaal Roy Kapur, Anurag Basu, Neha Dhupia and Anju Alva Naik also feature in key supporting roles.

Nikhil Madhok, director and head of originals at Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios India, said “Don’t Be Shy’ is one of our most cherished films, and we’re thrilled to finally announce its global streaming premiere.” The makers are looking forward to audiences experiencing the world of Shy and connecting with its heartfelt story.

In a joint statement, Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt, co-founders of Eternal Sunshine Productions, said "Don't Be Shy has been extremely special to us from the very beginning, and we couldn’t be prouder to see it come to life. It captures something so honest about being young—the friendships that shape you, the first loves that change you, the heartbreaks that stay with you, and the process of gradually figuring out who you are. What excites us most is this brilliant young cast; their energy, vulnerability, and chemistry are magnetic, and they bring such life and honesty to these characters. We can’t wait for audiences in India and around the world to meet Shy and get swept into her wonderful, chaotic world.”

Don’t Be Shy will premiere exclusively on Prime Video on September 25, 2026. The film will stream in Hindi with English subtitles across India and more than 240 countries and territories worldwide.

items.title: Exclusive: Aneet Padda Approached for a Crucial Role in Ranbir Kapoorâs Brahmastra 2

Aneet Padda is in talks for a key role alongside Ranbir Kapoor in Brahmastra 2. Read the full story here.

items.description:
Aneet Padda is in talks for a key role alongside Ranbir Kapoor in Brahmastra 2. Read the full story here.

Fans have been waiting for an update on Brahmastra 2 ever since Brahmastra Part One: Shiva hit the big screen. Directed by Ayan Mukerji, the 2022 film starred Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt in the lead, with Amitabh Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan, Nagarjuna and Mouni Roy in pivotal roles.

Speculation around the sequel has been doing the rounds for some time, particularly after the post-credit scene in the first film teased Deepika Padukone's character. While her face was blurred, the sequence showed her holding a child, leading to plenty of theories about her role in the next installment. Deepika is expected to have a crucial part in Brahmastra 2.

Now, amid the ongoing buzz around the sequel, we hear that Aneet Padda has also been approached for a role in the film.

Aneet, who rose to prominence with Saiyaara last year, has quickly become one of the names to watch out for. She is currently working on Shakti Shalini, and according to our sources, the actress has been approached for a crucial role opposite Ranbir Kapoor in Brahmastra 2.

A source tells us, “Aneet has been approached for an important role in Brahmastra 2. The conversations are currently underway, but nothing has been finalised yet. It is a very different space from what audiences have seen her do so far, which makes the possibility of her joining the franchise interesting.”

If Aneet does come on board, her casting would certainly add another interesting layer to the already ambitious ensemble of Brahmastra 2.

items.title: EMOMEE launches first show on Netflix, marks global streaming debut 15 months after launch
items.summary:
EMOMEE, the fast-growing children's entertainment brand helping children build life skills through its beloved characters, E, Mo & Mee, has officially launched its first show on Netflix.

EMOMEE launches first show on Netflix, marks global...
items.description:
EMOMEE, the fast-growing children's entertainment brand helping children build life skills through its beloved characters, E, Mo & Mee, has officially launched its first show on Netflix.

EMOMEE launches first show on Netflix, marks global streaming debut 15 months after launch

Just 15 months after launch, EMOMEE has grown into one of India's fastest-rising preschool IPs, reaching families in over 100 countries, crossing more than a billion views, building a community of over 2.5 million subscribers, and earning national recognition on Shark Tank India, where the founders received offers from all five Sharks.

The Netflix launch marks EMOMEE’s global streaming debut and an important milestone in its ambition to build a world-class children’s entertainment franchise from India.

The first series, EMOMEE: Big Skills for Little Ones, Minis, features 20 curated 11-minute episodes that bring together the brand's most-loved stories around core life skills such as confidence, kindness, curiosity, emotional intelligence and problem-solving. Designed for preschoolers and their families, the series transforms everyday moments into engaging adventures that make learning life skills genuinely fun.

"This launch represents much more than a new distribution platform. It is another milestone in building EMOMEE into a global entertainment company. Every step we've taken - from growing a loyal audience to expanding onto streaming platforms - is helping us build a long-term franchise that will extend beyond content into consumer products, licensing and live experiences," said Pooja Jauhari, Founder & CEO of EMOMEE.

Built on the belief that entertainment can prepare children for the future, EMOMEE creates stories that help young audiences develop the life skills they'll need in an increasingly complex world. Every episode is designed around meaningful themes including resilience, communication, empathy, confidence and curiosity, wrapped in playful adventures that children love.

The Netflix launch is the latest step in EMOMEE's broader growth strategy as the company continues expanding its global footprint across streaming, live experiences, consumer products and licensing. Later this year, EMOMEE will showcase its growing slate and franchise ambitions at MIPCOM as it builds new international distribution and licensing partnerships.

items.title: Ravi Tejaâs Irumudi Storms Box Office With Record-breaking Opening Weekend
items.summary:
Ravi Teja’s Irumudi is the fastest film ever to cross the Rs 80 crore gross mark, according to its makers.

Ravi Teja-starrer Irumudi has taken the box office by storm, according to trade reports.
items.description:
Ravi Teja’s Irumudi is the fastest film ever to cross the Rs 80 crore gross mark, according to its makers.

Ravi Teja-starrer Irumudi has taken the box office by storm, according to trade reports. The revenge action thriller has reportedly crossed a worldwide gross of Rs 71.87 crore in its opening weekend, with India contributing Rs 58.37 crore, as per Sacnilk.

The film has shown a steady upward trajectory since its release. Irumudi opened with Rs 17.75 crore on Friday before climbing to Rs 18.82 crore on Saturday. Sunday witnessed another jump, with the film collecting Rs 21.80 crore.

Makers call it a record irumudi

Mythri Movie Makers have meanwhile claimed that Irumudi is the fastest film ever to cross the Rs 80 crore gross mark in the regional space.

The film, which also stars Baby Nakshatra and Sai Kumar in important roles, has put up strong numbers across key Telugu markets. In the Nizam region, Irumudi recorded its biggest single-day collection on Sunday, with the three-day performance indicating strong momentum. Trade trackers expect the film to cross a major gross milestone in Telangana alone.

The Ceded region has also responded strongly to the Ravi Teja-starrer. Known for embracing well-made films with mass elements, the territory has delivered solid collections through the opening weekend. Trade reports suggest that the film could potentially generate an unprecedented return on investment for a Ravi Teja title in the region.

Ravi Teja’s biggest blockbuster yet? irumudi

The momentum appears to have carried into Monday as well. More than 230 shows in Hyderabad and over 75 shows in Vizag were reportedly fast filling or sold out at the time of reporting. Trade watchers believe the film could go on to become Ravi Teja’s first Rs 100 crore-share film.

The film has also made an impact overseas, crossing the US$1 million mark in North America and continuing its run.

The makers have further shared impressive ticketing figures, claiming that Irumudi has sold more than 2.5 million tickets across BookMyShow and District. The team has dubbed the film’s impressive run “Ravanna’s Rampage.”

items.title: Rashmika Mandanna Attends High-profile Event With Vijay Deverakonda After Weeks of Rest
items.summary:
Rashmika Mandanna makes her first public appearance with Vijay Deverakonda following her hip injury.

On Sunday evening, Rashmika Mandanna made her first public appearance following a painful hip injury that forced her to take weeks of...
items.description:
Rashmika Mandanna makes her first public appearance with Vijay Deverakonda following her hip injury.

On Sunday evening, Rashmika Mandanna made her first public appearance following a painful hip injury that forced her to take weeks of rest. The actress attended a high-profile engagement ceremony in Hyderabad alongside her husband, actor Vijay Deverakonda. The duo is currently part of Ranabaali, marking their first project together after their marriage.

Rashmika sustained a detached tendon in her right hip while filming an intense dance sequence for her upcoming project Mysaa. The injury forced her to temporarily step away from work and focus on her recovery at home. Her first public appearance since the setback suggested that the actress is gradually getting back to her routine.

At the event, Vijay stayed by her side as the couple walked into the venue together. Fans online welcomed Rashmika’s return to the public eye following her recovery period, though she appeared to have a subtle limp, indicating that her healing process is still underway.

Earlier this month, Rashmika opened up about the injury and explained that, despite the tendon detachment, the pain was bearable. “There are four tendons on each side of your hip that connects your hip to your leg and one of those tendons on my right hip apparently had detached and that has to attach again, for me to be able to lift my leg up and stuff... My god that's the most aggressive film (Mysaa) I have ever done for sure!” she wrote.

Hero #VijayDeverakonda and #RashmikaMandanna snapped at producer #NiranjanReddy’s son’s engagement in Hyderabad. 💓💓 pic.twitter.com/BKAlsKrJBt

— Milagro Movies (@MilagroMovies) August 24, 2026

She further reflected on the unexpected break, adding, “I feel like this is God saying you will never take a break if it's left to you, so here... let me do it for you! You know all these injuries I have had are random af—freak accidents. What are the odds.”

Rashmika will next be seen in Mysaa, a female-led film slated for release later this year. 

Meanwhile, Ranabaali, which marks her collaboration with Vijay Deverakonda, has been postponed from its earlier September 11 release date.

items.title: Poonam Dhillon Breaks Silence on CINTAA Row
items.summary: The ongoing crisis within the Cine and TV Artistes Association (CINTAA) has taken another turn, with president Poonam Dhillon addressing the allegations levelled against the organisation’s leadership.
items.description:
The ongoing crisis within the Cine and TV Artistes Association (CINTAA) has taken another turn, with president Poonam Dhillon addressing the allegations levelled against the organisation’s leadership. Speaking at a CINTAA press conference, the veteran actress said she was deeply hurt by the statements made by former general secretary Upasana Singh and other members of the previous Executive Committee.

Poonam Dhillon says CINTAA’s reputation has been damaged

Dhillon said she felt compelled to present CINTAA’s side of the story, arguing that the allegations could influence public perception if left unchallenged. “I am very sad that the general secretary of the previous committee ruined CINTAA’s name. She defamed CINTAA. Such wrong things about CINTAA have never been said in our history. So, I am very sad about that,” Poonam Dhillon said in a chat with media.

She added, “We need to clear a few things. Because, until the right version reaches you, people will think that they are speaking the truth.”

The comments come amid an increasingly public dispute over the functioning of CINTAA. Dhillon and senior vice-president Padmini Kolhapure have faced allegations of concentrating decision-making within a small group and sidelining members who disagreed with them. Dhillon has previously rejected the accusations, describing some of the claims made against her and Kolhapure as offensive.

Eleven members resign as allegations escalate

The controversy intensified earlier this month when 11 members of CINTAA’s 21-member Executive Committee resigned. The elected members who stepped down included Hemant Pandey, Mukesh Rishi, Sahila Chadha, Hetal Parmar, Puneet Issar, Vindu Dara Singh, Vikas Verma and Deepak Parashar. The resignations were accompanied by calls for fresh elections and concerns over the association’s functioning.

Upasana Singh, who was then serving as CINTAA’s general secretary, confirmed the resignations and said complaints had been submitted regarding the functioning of the association. Among the allegations were claims that important decisions and official communications were being handled without adequate consultation with the Executive Committee.

Singh later publicly accused Dhillon and Kolhapure of running the organisation in an undemocratic manner. She alleged that show-cause notices were issued to members who opposed the leadership, while former treasurer Deepak Parashar also claimed that authority within CINTAA had become increasingly concentrated around the two veteran actresses.

The allegations have been strongly contested by Dhillon, who has maintained that she and Kolhapure have been working in the interests of CINTAA. The dispute has since evolved into a wider debate about transparency, collective decision-making and the functioning of the actors’ association.

For Dhillon, however, the immediate concern appears to be the organisation’s public image. Her latest comments underline the widening divide within CINTAA, with both sides continuing to put forward sharply different versions of what has transpired.

The veteran actress, meanwhile, remains active on screen. Her recent film appearances include the Punjabi releases Madhaniyan and Jaggo Aayi Aa in 2025, while her most recent Hindi film appearance was in Plan A Plan B, which released in 2022.
